lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four observable vertical columns along the posterior flank, with decreasing density moving toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting horizontal rows of spots to form a visible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the visible lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature extending from the posterior mid-body to the caudal fin origin, defined by a sharp intensity gradient between the illuminated upper edge and the shadowed lower edge.
